transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I sign off on the checkout cluster's autoscaling and operating policy for the next production traffic cycle, I need to hear from each of your areas. We've got the routine availability tests passing, and Monday morning is our next production traffic cycle. The cluster currently scales between 10 and 30 nodes with automatic consolidation enabled. Per our standard infra operating review, I need reliability, finance, checkout operations, and security to report any constraints before I approve. What are you all seeing on your end?

transcript.text: During a security baseline review today, I confirmed that checkout pods may scale only onto the hardened node pool because the standard pool exposes a node-local metadata path. The finding is awaiting a formal security ticket, so this constraint isn't captured in the current autoscaling policy. This means the cluster's node scaling needs to account for the fact that checkout workloads cannot land on standard pool nodes.
